title: pp.fft-pitchshift-st~
description: `pp.fft-pitchshift-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.fft-pitchshift~`, using Pd’s phase-vocoder implementation to transpose left and right input signals by a value in cents. Its creation arguments set the FFT block size (default 1024) and overlap (default 4), which can also be changed with control messages.
